color.surface.secondary.description: Lower-emphasis surface for grouped content and alternate rows.

color.surface.raised.description: Surface for content visually elevated above the primary surface.

color.surface.overlay.description: Surface for floating panels layered above page content.

color.text.disabled.description: Text for disabled or inactive content.

color.text.inverse.description: Foreground text paired with high-emphasis primary action surfaces.

color.text.error.description: Text that explains a form validation error.

color.border.subtle.description: Low-emphasis decorative dividers; do not rely on this as the only boundary for an interactive control.

color.border.strong.description: High-emphasis outlines and boundaries for content surfaces.

color.border.error.description: Control boundary indicating a validation error.

color.accent.border.description: Boundary color for accent callouts, contrasted against the accent surface and page canvas.

color.status.success.fg.description: Text on the success status surface.

color.status.info.fg.description: Text on the informational status surface.

color.status.neutral.fg.description: Text on the neutral status surface.

color.status.warning.fg.description: Text on the warning status surface.

color.status.error.fg.description: Text on the error status surface.

border.width.subtle.description: Low-emphasis border thickness for separators and secondary boundaries.

border.width.default.description: Default border thickness for themeable controls and surfaces.

border.width.strong.description: High-emphasis border thickness for prominent boundaries.

shadow.color.description: Solid shadow color for block-style component shadows.

shadow.offset.surface.description: Hard offset used by raised component surfaces.

shadow.offset.control.description: Hard offset used by interactive controls.

shadow.elevation.surface.description: Complete box-shadow treatment for raised content surfaces.

shadow.elevation.control.description: Complete box-shadow treatment for interactive controls.

radius.surface.description: Bounded corners for content panels, cards, code blocks, media, and other surfaces; never use action-control or full radii for these defaults.

radius.control.description: Default action button and intentionally pill-shaped action control radius, not a content surface radius.

radius.tooltip.description: Default corner radius for supplementary tooltip content.

radius.form-control.description: Corner radius for single-line text and select controls.

radius.form-group.description: Corner radius for grouped form fieldsets.

radius.textarea.description: Corner radius for multi-line text controls.

radius.menu.description: Corner radius for dropdown menu panels.
